_comment: READ-ONLY census captured 2026-07-19 from a temp COPY of the live corpus's .lore/lore.db (never the live file itself — copied + WAL-checkpointed to a scratch dir, queried via sqlite3, then discarded). Source: SPEC-056 migration-shape-spike task. Drives packages/lore/tests/fixtures/phase-migration/seed.json's realistic baseline shapes. This file is a point-in-time snapshot, not live data — it will drift as the corpus grows; treat it as provenance for the fixture, not as ground truth for future migration runs.

evidence_array_size_stats.note: max observed is 16 — NO live task exceeds (or nears) the 50-entry cap; the near-cap (49) and over-cap-when-merged (55) scenarios in seed.json are SYNTHESIZED, not observed.

note_legacy_phase: 0 live tasks carry extra.legacy_phase — the SPEC-023 migration residue scenario required by SPEC-056 AC-P-5 does not exist in the current corpus and is SYNTHESIZED in seed.json.
note_origin: 0 — the `origin` field does not exist pre-SPEC-056; it is the migration's OWN annotation, added by PhaseMigrationService when merging source-task evidence into a phase doc. seed.json deliberately omits it too (pre-migration state).
note_empty_declared_phase: 0 live plans have a declared phase with zero referencing tasks — the empty-declared-phase scenario required by SPEC-056 P7 does not exist in the current corpus and is SYNTHESIZED (twice, independently) in seed.json.
